text: The company register lists HIRU ENVIRONNEMENT (SIREN 943903278) as Président de SAS of GUYOT ENVIRONNEMENT (SIREN 430004671, Brest), and Erwan Guyot as Président de SAS of HIRU ENVIRONNEMENT, with Giulia Guyot, Frédéric Jestin and Bertrand Le Floc'h as Directeurs Généraux. The group's governance page says the family company is run by Erwan and Giulia Guyot, Bertrand Le Floch and Frédéric Jestin, and that the group chose to stay independent. The club's partner page names Guyot Erwan as Président and gives 300 employees.
short: Guyot Environnement is chaired by the holding Hiru Environnement, led by Erwan Guyot; the group calls itself a family company.
